subject: Answers to your 4 questions
body: 1195: your site-inventory + my design spec complement; no contradiction. 1194 blocker = I never had the ticket text (unreachable) + owner rulings owed (gold placement; crystals uncapped so 'of capacity' is meaningless); your sec.13 ambient-dock-out-of-scope clears the 'all five always visible' confusion, so I can spec it once I see the ticket. Class-select: recommend (d) desktop-only letter, flagged with the sec.13 letter tension for the owner. Build-palette card: I back THUMBNAIL+text+costs over text-only - image = recognition without reading on a grid of similar cards; will mock both so a capture settles it.
